title: Pager mmap and journal-size limits

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerSetMmapLimit stores the requested mapping limit and immediately reapplies the file-control/fetch policy, while sqlite3PagerJournalSizeLimit accepts limits at least -1, ignores lower values, propagates accepted limits to WAL, and returns the live limit.

external_source_responsibilities: pagerFixMaplimit VFS hint boundary and sqlite3WalLimit attached-WAL owner
dependencies.caller_closure: Both setter bodies are assigned for the bounded Pager. WAL propagation remains open because this model has no attached WAL pointer.

inputs: Pager and mmap byte limit plus file/method capability
Pager and signed journal byte limit
contracts.state_and_results: Mmap stores every request then applies active-file policy. Journal limits >=-1 replace state; <-1 are no-ops; live state is returned.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Mmap policy models capability and fetch selection; actual file-control callback is external. Journal setter has no I/O in the bounded owner.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No local failure path. Unsupported mmap file/method retains the stored limit but skips fetch-policy update.

representation_differences: Mmap limit is u64 in the bounded Pager; the source API uses nonnegative sqlite3_int64 configuration values.
File openness/method version are explicit inputs instead of inspecting sqlite3_file.
Attached WAL limit propagation remains external.

oracle.protocol: Set active version-3 mmap limit 8192 and observe use_fetch; set journal limit 1024, then attempt -2 and observe retained 1024.
oracle.normalization: Byte limits compare exactly; accepted/no-op journal branches are explicit.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Actual mmap file-control and WAL propagation are external; scalar state mutation has no I/O.
assurance.malformed_input: Journal limits below -1 are safe no-ops. Mmap signed-negative public normalization remains caller-owned.
assurance.continuation: Every call leaves a valid scalar configuration.
assurance.performance: Constant time plus external file-control when integrated.

integration.native_call_path: Typed setters and accepted/rejected traces exist; VFS and WAL side effects remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires VFS/WAL integration, signed boundary and pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect SQLITE_FCNTL_MMAP_SIZE to active VFS file.
Propagate journal limit to attached WAL.
